title: At-deploy Record
description: An at-deploy record states that a deploy job carried out an action of a plan item that is marked at_deploy, at one environment. One record per file, spec/extras/verification/dep-<NNNN>.json, written by 'specdev plan record --at-deploy' and never by hand. The file holds a records array of exactly one record, and the file name without .json is the record id.

records.description: The one at-deploy record of this file.

items.description: An at-deploy record: the outcome of one at_deploy action of one plan item at one environment, against one code tree.

deploy_id.description: Id of this record: dep- and a number of at least four digits. Equals the file name without .json. Example: dep-0001.

about.description: The one plan item the action belongs to, as a one-item array.

milestone.description: Id of the Step 14 roadmap milestone the plan item belongs to.

action.description: Id of the action of that item this record is about. Example: a03.

env.description: The environment the deploy job ran for: staging or prod, one of the stages the action is marked at_deploy for.

tag.description: Release tag the deploy job deployed. Optional.

tree.description: Id of the code tree the deploy job ran against (a git tree id).

outcome.description: done: the action was carried out. failed: it was tried and did not work.

recorded_at.description: UTC time the tool wrote the record, ISO 8601. Informational: nothing compares it.

git_author.description: The git author of the deploy job as git reports it. A deploy job often has no git identity: the tool then writes name ci and an empty email, which this record allows.

email.description: Email of the git author; empty when the deploy job has no git identity.
